items.plain: A user who once had a failed digest never gets another one.
items.threshold: Fails for the first failed job, at any size.
items.fix_direction: Use a job id that includes the day, and remove failed jobs after a retry window.

items.plain: A stuck digest stays stuck until someone restarts the worker.
items.fix_direction: Set a stall timeout and a retry limit on the worker.

items.plain: Sending one notification to a big group queues one job per person.
items.threshold: Around 10k recipients the queue backs up for minutes.
items.fix_direction: Batch recipients, a few hundred per job.

items.threshold: About 2k rows at one remote call per row exceed the request time limit.
items.fix_direction: Fetch the profiles once per import, in bulk.

items.plain: Reindexing a big workspace gets slower with every page.
items.threshold: Past about 40k notes each page reads more than it returns.
items.fix_direction: Page by the last seen id instead of skipping.

items.plain: Opening a large workspace reads the whole notes collection.
items.threshold: Near 100k notes the list takes seconds.
items.fix_direction: Add an index on workspaceId and the sort field.

items.plain: Signing in gets slower as the user count grows.
items.threshold: Near 300k users the lookup is noticeable.
items.fix_direction: Add a unique index on email.

items.plain: The notes collection may outgrow its storage plan.
items.threshold: Calculated near 2M notes platform-wide, depending on settings not seen.
items.fix_direction: Plan an archive for old notes.

items.plain: Each open workspace keeps memory that is never freed.
items.threshold: Grows with use, no single breaking size.
items.fix_direction: Cap the in-memory cache and expire entries.

items.plain: Health checks add database load on every probe.
items.fix_direction: Answer the liveness probe without the database.

items.plain: The workspace page freezes for big workspaces.
items.threshold: The page freezes from about 5k notes, by calculation.
items.fix_direction: Render the list in windows and fetch it in pages.

items.plain: Typing in the note filter lags on long lists.
items.fix_direction: Sort once and debounce the filter.
